text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
One weekend, I'm walking around<n>town after
finishing up some errands,<n>when I run into Wonder
Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I'm not up to anything in particular,<n>just taking a
stroll. I mean, how could<n>I resist with such nice
weather?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: It is indeed prime strolling weather.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh! ...You wouldn't mind?
choice_data_list: I've got nothing to do, so... up to you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Well then, in that case...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, that's right. While I have you,<n>there's
someplace I'd like to take<n>you, so why don't you
follow me?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I don't know where I was expecting<n>her to lead me,
but it sure wasn't a<n>pool hall.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, it's my first time, actually.<n>Rickey was
saying she wanted to<n>take us here sometime, you
see.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But then I got to thinking maybe a<n>trendy game like
this would pique<n>your interest too.

text_block_list.name: Announcement
text_block_list.text:
Come one, come all! Can you pocket<n>the balls in
this special configuration?!<n>You get two chances!
Winners will be<n>presented with a luxurious prize!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
A luxurious present? Look at that, it's<n>a one-day
free pass! Rickey would be<n>over the moon... You
think I could win<n>it?
choice_data_list: Sure! Looks fun. Why don't we give it a try?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Roll... Clink!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, would you look at that! You<n>were so close. I
whiffed completely,<n>but you're a natural at this.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My first try ends in failure. I get one<n>more attempt.
My shoulders stiffen<n>up from the pressure.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Trainer, deep breaths now,<n>deep breaths. In
moments like this,<n>it's best to pause and collect
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Like this. In... and out...

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Her sweet smile and laid-back<n>demeanor combine
to take all the<n>tension right out of my shoulders.<n>Now
I'm ready.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Clack! Thud!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ohhh my!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And in they go, every last one! You're<n>so good at
this, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Couldn't have done it without you!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense, I didn't do anything but<n>watch. The credit
belongs to you.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now, this cafe I heard about from<n>Falco. I figured
you might like these<n>places that everyone posts
about on<n>the Umastagram.

text_block_list.name: Waitress
text_block_list.text:
Here you are! One Pancake Mountain,<n>with a big ol'
dollop of whipped<n>cream and extra fruit and butter!
choice_data_list: Oh, wow... It really is a mountain!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Goodness me... I'm at a loss for<n>words. Something
this impressive is<n>bound to give you all sorts of
good<n>luck.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Praise be, praise be!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
It does seem plausible that a stack of<n>pancakes
this massive would have<n>some kind of divine
power.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Now then, shall we dig in?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text: Nom, nom...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Ooh! It's so fluffy—this is to die for!

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
I can't remember the last time I had<n>this much fun
eating out. It makes the<n>food all the more delicious.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It was Tarumae who told me about<n>this store.
Trainer, you were talking<n>about wanting a new
jacket, weren't<n>you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Here, how about this one? The fabric<n>looks of good
quality, and the make is<n>sturdy too.
choice_data_list: Good find! I'll go try it on.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer, it looks wonderful on you!<n>Now how
about you turn around for<n>me real quick?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, there's a big old hole in the<n>back. A bug
must have gotten to it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Fashion? So you're telling me it'ssupposed to be like that? Sigh. It's sohard to keep up with all these trends.But I learned something new.
choice_data_list: How about I pick something out for you, too?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you mean it? Well, if you're<n>offering, then I
suppose I'll have you<n>give my wardrobe a trendy
makeover. Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well... I owe you a big thank you.<n>Didn't mean to
keep you all day long.
choice_data_list: No, I should be thanking you.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
From billiards to the cafe and then the<n>clothing
store, she took care to pick<n>places she thought I
would enjoy,<n>and I appreciate that.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I didn't do anything. Everything<n>was so new
and unfamiliar to me,<n>I'm afraid I only wasted more
of your<n>time. But, yes...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It really was a fun day. I learned so<n>many new
things from you, it was<n>hard for me not to get all
giddy.
choice_data_list: I had fun too. Plus it was relaxing.
I had fun too. Plus it was relaxing.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
No matter the place, when I'm with<n>Wonder Acute,
time seems to pass<n>more slowly, and I always find
a<n>smile on my face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: You don't say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...I'd like that. We'll have to find the<n>time to do this
again.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... We should "hang" again? Can<n>you believe
it?

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
My, my! Seeing such a look of delight<n>on your face
just warms my heart.<n>Try the tea too. I put it in a
thermos,<n>so it's nice and steamy.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Trainer had that same smile again...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
That's good... Glad to know I wasn't<n>the only one
having fun.
